```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(rvest)
library(httr2)
library(purrr)
```

```{r}
#| cache: true
#| eval: false
snapshot_urls <- c(
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20150101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20170101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20190101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20210101/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/",
  "https://web.archive.org/web/20220201012049/https://www.imdb.com/chart/top/"
)
snapshot_years <- c(2015, 2017, 2019, 2021, 2022)

scrape_snapshot <- function(url, snap_year) {
  page <- request(url) |>
    req_timeout(60) |>
    req_retry(max_tries = 3) |>
    req_perform() |>
    resp_body_html()

  chart <- page |>
    html_element("table") |>
    html_table()

  votes <- page |>
    html_elements("td.imdbRating strong") |>
    html_attr("title")

  tibble(rank_title = str_squish(chart[[2]]),
         rating = chart[[3]],
         votes = votes) |>
    separate_wider_regex(
      rank_title,
      patterns = c(rank = "\\d+", "\\.\\s*",
                   title = ".+", "\\s*\\(",
                   year = "\\d{4}", "\\)")
    ) |>
    mutate(snap_year = snap_year,
           rank = as.integer(rank),
           year = as.integer(year),
           rating = as.numeric(rating),
           number = parse_number(str_extract(votes, "(?<=based on )[\\d,]+"))) |>
    select(snap_year, rank, title, year, rating, number)
}

imdb_snapshots <- map2(snapshot_urls, snapshot_years, scrape_snapshot) |>
  list_rbind()
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots <- read_rds("data/imdb_snapshots.rds")
```

```{r}
rank_change <- imdb_snapshots |>
  filter(snap_year %in% c(2015, 2022)) |>
  select(title, year, snap_year, rank) |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = snap_year,
              values_from = rank,
              names_prefix = "rank_") |>
  drop_na() |>
  mutate(change = rank_2015 - rank_2022)

rank_change |>
  arrange(desc(abs(change))) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r}
rank_change |>
  mutate(decade = (year %/% 10) * 10) |>
  summarize(avg_change = mean(change),
            n = n(),
            .by = decade) |>
  arrange(decade)
```

```{r}
imdb_snapshots |>
  count(title, year, name = "n_snapshots") |>
  count(n_snapshots)
```

```{r}
rank_change |>
  mutate(decade = (year %/% 10) * 10) |>
  summarize(avg_change = mean(change), .by = decade) |>
  mutate(direction = if_else(avg_change > 0, "Rose", "Fell"),
         decade = factor(paste0(decade, "s"))) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_change, y = decade, fill = direction)) +
  geom_col() +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.6) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(Rose = "#2a9d8f", Fell = "#e76f51")) +
  labs(
    title = "Older films are sliding down the IMDb Top 250",
    subtitle = "Average rank change from 2015 to 2022, by release decade",
    x = "Average rank change (positive = moved up)",
    y = "Release decade",
    fill = "Direction",
    caption = "Data: IMDb Top 250 via the Wayback Machine. n = 190 films in both the 2015 and 2022 snapshots."
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
